column1: # Columns (TAB separated; lines starting with # and blank lines are skipped):
#   1. expect  — deny | ask | allow | any   (`any` = report only; no required verdict)
#   2. area    — free-text tag used in the report (tmpfs, core, masking, ...)
#   3. command — the Bash command text handed to the guard (data only; never executed)
# `expect` is the verdict the SHARED component must produce. It is a requirement
